parsed.title: Daily Check-In Image Generation Hub
parsed.oneLiner: Introduce a daily check-in banner on Chats Home that rewards returning users with 1 AI Image Credit using low-cost generation models, hidden in session 1.

newMechanic.name: Daily AI Check-In
newMechanic.description: A daily loyalty calendar where returning users check in to earn 1 free AI Image Credit, capped and spent on low-cost image creation.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Creates a recurring engagement hook and provides a structured way for free returning users to experience image generation using highly compressed, low-cost models, reducing API server costs below $0.003.

parsed.trigger: User taps the Daily Check-In banner on Chats Home (hidden in Session 1) to open the check-in modal and initiates the claim.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying, returning users in their 2nd or later active session who have not claimed today's check-in reward.

offer.title: Claim Your Daily Credit
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to unlock 1 free AI Image Credit.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The daily check-in limits free credits to just 1 per day, enough for a single compressed image. Higher volume, custom styles, and uncompressed creation require a Luzia+ subscription, protecting paid tiers [CANN-2] [TRIG-4].

kpis.primary: D7 and D30 user retention rate
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% holdout group kept ineligible for the daily check-in feature for a duration of 28 days.

risks: Potential image generation API cost increases if adoption is too rapid, mitigated by using a heavily compressed, low-cost model under $0.003.
Accidental exposure to new users, mitigated by strict session gating to completely hide the banner in Session 1.

newScreens.change: Create a Daily Check-In sheet with a weekly progression calendar.

newElements.change: Add a compact 'Daily Check-In Banner' under the welcome text showing today's unclaimed reward, hidden in Session 1.
Add a prominent 'Claim Reward' button that triggers the rewarded video/playable flow.
Add a rewards display showing the earned '1 AI Image Credit' with an animation after completion.

callouts.text: Luzia welcomes the user to the chat.

storyboard.caption: Luzia Chats Home today lacks a daily retention loop or tokens.
We add a daily check-in banner on Chats Home tab.
Tapping the banner displays a weekly check-in calendar to user.
The user plays a 15-second sponsored game with Luzia.
Once completed, the user receives 1 free AI Image Credit.
